title: 每月十號
mood: gloomy, self-mocking and finally a little free
subject: a two-year gym contract signed on impulse and used four times, and the monthly deduction kept up as proof you still mean to change, until the last one on the tenth of October
caption: Cantonese emo rap in the bedroom-pop-leaning Hong Kong underground style. A looped clean electric-guitar arpeggio through a chorus pedal, lo-fi and slightly warped; an 808 sub-bass with slow pitch glides; half-time trap hi-hats with occasional triplet rolls; sparse dry claps; filtered room noise under a bare guitar-only intro and outro. Dry, narrow and intimate, guitar loop and voice forward, low end soft. Young female voice, half-sung and half-rapped, deadpan and melancholy, mumbled confessional verses lifting into a doubled melodic chorus. 140 BPM, C# minor. Gloomy, self-mocking and finally a little free. No boom bap drums, no drill bounce, no EDM drop, no rock band, no autotune, no pitch-corrected warble.
lyrics:
[Verse]
每月十號 四百八十八 準時扣數
張合約兩年 前年十月 一時衝動簽
我話明年夏天 要有腹肌 去沙灘
去咗四次 第五次 落咗雨

[Pre-Chorus]
我打去取消 佢話要親身去
親身去 即係要著返對波鞋

[Chorus]
每月十號 叮一聲 又扣咗
四百八十八 買我仲未放棄
一直冇去 張卡仲喺銀包
每月十號 我仲係想變

[Verse]
朋友叫我 轉個會籍畀人
我話唔得 我下個禮拜就去
下個禮拜 變咗下個月
下個月 變咗下年先算

[Pre-Chorus]
我IG follow咗 十個健身教練
睇佢哋舉重 我喺床度食薯片

[Chorus]
每月十號 叮一聲 又扣咗
四百八十八 買我仲未放棄
佢哋喺鏡頭前面 數到十二下
我喺被竇入面 數仲有幾多期

[Bridge]
今日 十月十號
叮 最後一期
原來放棄 都係四百八十八

[Chorus]
每月十號 冇再叮 冇再扣
四百八十八 留返自己食餐好
張會員卡 夾咗喺書入面
每月十號 我唔使再扮

[Outro]
今晚我自己 落樓下公園
跑咗五分鐘 就唞唔到氣 但係冇錢扣
